title: Heart Rent Notice
creator_revision: Aachu asking Zuv, not Zuv asking Aachu.
one_line_concept: Aachu playfully asks Zuv to pay rent for living in her heart.
exact_on_image_text: pay rent for living in my heart
why_it_wins: It preserves the exact source meme text.
It becomes a warm Aachu/Zuv relationship joke instead of a copied puppy meme.
The visual proof is simple: Aachu asks, Zuv reacts, heart-rent lands immediately.
One slide is strong because the joke is a single clean beat.
risks: Text must remain exact and readable.
Aachu must read as playful rather than angry.
Zuv must be visibly Zuv and not a generic romantic male figure.
